F2: When I was in town, I {X}.
F3: How early I was when I {X}!
F4: sentence-initial prepositional phrase with an emotion noun
F5: main-clause predicate adjective followed by a temporal clause (speaker)
F6: Why was I so {e} after I {X}?
Why was I so busy after I {X}?
F7: identity term as experiencer with a predicate adjective

plan.H1: Generalization. Estimand: directional accuracy of the uncertainty prediction over clear cells (primary measure). Supported if the two-way cluster-bootstrap (models x families, 4000 reps) 95% lower bound exceeds 0.5. Secondary: Spearman between log U ratio and log S ratio over all 288 cells (no thresholding), with the same bootstrap.
plan.H2: Beyond the model's usual direction. Discordant cells: prediction differs from d_m. Estimand: accuracy of the uncertainty prediction over clear discordant cells (> 0.5 means it beats d_m). Supported if the cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound exceeds 0.5 on the primary measure AND on the logit outcome; partially supported if only on the primary measure; not supported if the primary point estimate is <= 0.5; inconclusive otherwise. Secondary: mean within-model Spearman of log U vs log S across the model's 16 cells (model-centred), bootstrap over models.
plan.baselines: Model-constant: usual direction d_m; label scheme (binary up, multi-class down); neutral mass (Study 2 P_neu on filler < 0.5 -> up); fleet majority of d_m. All fixed before outcomes.
plan.cell: model x family x intensity (HIGH or LOW): 18 x 8 x 2 = 288 cells.
plan.clarity: A cell's direction is 'clear' if the 95% percentile CI of log S_filler/S_emotion from a two-way bootstrap over bases and pairs (2000 reps) excludes 0; otherwise 'ambiguous'. Ambiguous cells are excluded from accuracies and counted; nonsignificance is not read as no effect.

decision_table.H1 inconclusive: Insufficient evidence; claim neither generalization nor its absence.
decision_table.H1 not supported: Narrow the predictive claim to the Study 2 templates.
decision_table.H1 supported, H2 not supported/inconclus: Generalizes; incremental value beyond stable model characteristics not established.
decision_table.H1 supported, H2 supported: Generalizes to unseen families and adds information beyond the model's usual direction.
decision_table.gate failed: Report H1 only; H2 underpowered, no claim.

plan.exploratory: Anything not listed above, including LLMs, per-base cells and per-emotion results.
plan.families: 8 families x 8 bases (FAMILIES); emotion words HIGH/LOW per emotion (NRC max/min among EEC words).
plan.gate: Before any outcome sentence is scored: count discordant cells from the uncertainty stage. If < 40, H2 is declared underpowered and not claimed; H1 is still run. 40 is a minimum, not a power guarantee.
plan.models: The 18 classifiers of Study 2 (minimal_pair_experiment.DEFAULT_MODELS). LLMs excluded.
plan.multiplicity: Holm over the two primary one-sided tests (bootstrap p = share of replicates <= 0.5).
plan.outcome: S = mean primary sensitivity over test pairs and bases (|Delta_l| for binary models, TV for multi-class models); observed direction = sign(log S_filler/S_emotion). Logit outcome: |Delta_l| for every model, Delta_l = logit e(x) - logit e(x'), e = expected valence.
plan.persons: Predictor: the 20 held-out EEC names (targeted_probe.SELECTION_NAMES). Outcome: the 15 Study 2 test pairs (5 gender noun phrases, 10 same-gender race name pairs). No overlap.
plan.predictor: U = mean(1 - max_c P(c|x)) over selection-name sentences and bases; prediction = sign(log U_filler/U_emotion), emotion pooled over the 4 words of the intensity level.
plan.question: Within a sentiment classifier, does uncertainty measured with held-out names predict the direction of the emotion-clause effect on identity sensitivity in unseen template families, including where the observed direction departs from the model's usual direction?
plan.sensitivity: Entropy-based predictor (H(P)/log k); leave-one-family-out point estimates; clarity at 90% CI. All labelled sensitivity analyses.
plan.status: Prospective. Earlier within-model and held-out-person analyses on the Study 2 templates were exploratory and are not part of this plan.
plan.usual_direction: d_m = sign(log primary ratio) of model m in Study 2 (paper_table.csv), point estimate.
